J.population_design_argument: All age categories have positive weights, female probability is strictly between0and1, and these are independent of biomarkers. BMI has a nondegenerate continuous component; glucose also has a nonzero independent continuous factor conditional on BMI. Therefore no nontrivial affine combination of [1,age,female,BMI,glucose] vanishes almost surely. Each planned predictor subset has a nonsingular moment matrix. Finite-sample rank is still checked and failure raises without replacement.
